biography: Terry 'The Terrier' Pudwell hails from a small market town in Oxfordshire, a far cry from the glitz and glamour of the motorsport world. His journey began not on the karting track, but on the muddy fields of his family's farm, tearing around on a battered quad bike. This early exposure to speed and risk ignited a passion that couldn't be contained. Pudwell's breakthrough came in the National Formula Ford series, where his raw talent and aggressive overtaking maneuvers caught the eye of Moorefield Motorsports. A defining moment was at Brands Hatch in 2015, where, starting from the back of the grid due to a qualifying mishap, he carved his way through the field to snatch a podium finish on the last lap. Now in his peak years, Pudwell is a seasoned veteran, bringing a no-holds-barred approach to every race weekend, and is currently in contract negotiations for the following season.
drivingStyle: Pudwell's driving style is characterized by relentless aggression and a fearless approach to overtaking. He's known for late-braking maneuvers and isn't afraid to put his car – and his rivals – on the edge. He attacks corners with gusto, often pushing the limits of grip, sometimes to his detriment. While his raw speed is undeniable, tire management has been a recurring challenge throughout his career. Under pressure, Pudwell tends to become even more aggressive, either resulting in spectacular victories or costly mistakes.
rivalries: Marco 'The Maestro' Silvani - A clash of styles. Silvani's smooth, calculated approach clashes with Pudwell's raw aggression, leading to frequent on-track battles.

James 'The Professor' Wright - A rivalry fueled by contrasting personalities and differing views on racing ethics. Wright accuses Pudwell of reckless driving, while Pudwell sees Wright as overly cautious.
Isabelle 'Izzy' Dubois - A relatively new rivalry forming due to several aggressive on track altercations during the 2023 season.
quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, even though they're falling apart.
Listens to a specific heavy metal track before every race to get 'pumped up'.
Insists on having a cup of chamomile tea before qualifying sessions, claiming it helps him 'focus'.
famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser."
careerHighlight: Winning the Silverstone Grand Prix in 2019 after a thrilling last-lap overtake on his main rival, Marco Silvani, securing his first and only Grand Prix victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at the Monaco Grand Prix in 2021, costing him valuable championship points and resulting in a lengthy pit lane argument with his team.
